Package Game_Logic

Class LevelController

java.lang.Object
Game_Logic.LevelController
public class LevelController extends Object
A class which holds the methods that control Levels and their visualisation. It contains loading different levels and creating the game.
Author:
Liam O'Reilly, Adam Bartlett, Rhys Evans
